result.title: World Models Need Not Be Right to Rank Policies Right: Relative Bounds and Audit Limits
result.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on World Models in Physical AI
result.summary: Selecting a reinforcement-learning (RL) policy usually requires additional environment interaction, while learned world models offer cheap but potentially biased evaluations. This raises two distinct questions: can shared model errors preserve pairwise rankings despite poor absolute values, and do they make a small number of real audits more informative? We derive an exact pairwise simulation identity and a relative bound separating common-mode Bellman residuals from policy-specific error. The analysis motivates RAVEL (Relative Auditing of Value Errors in Learned models), a selective policy tournament whose eliminations use held-out real outcomes. We test 45 SAC, TD3, and PPO policies per task in DMC cheetah-run and walker-walk. At rollout horizon 500, model rankings remain strong (Kendall tau = 0.962 and 0.800), and same-run differential-error ratios are 0.674 and 0.106. Yet mean paired audit-error correlations are only 0.007 and 0.090, and pairing changes standard deviation by -2.5 percent and +1.9 percent. Simultaneous intervals attain 99.98 percent and 99.75 percent coverage, but certify only 13.2 percent and 0 percent of decisions at eight audits. RAVEL improves low-budget walker-walk regret, whereas real-only successive halving is better at the largest budget, rejecting the precommitted twofold efficiency target. Frozen-model optimization lowers real return without increasing predicted return on average. Thus ranking fidelity, useful audit covariance, and upward model exploitation are distinct properties, separated in part by closed-loop trajectory divergence.

AI.brief_summary: 研究学习世界模型用于策略排序时，共享模型误差能否保留成对排序，以及少量真实审计能否支持更可靠的选择性淘汰；提出相对误差界与 RAVEL 锦标赛，并在 DMC 控制任务上检验排序保真度、审计协方差与预算效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「模型误差—真实证据—审计预算」的分解可为 LVR 中 latent 模拟与视觉证据核验的取舍、证据获取及停止决策提供概念线索，但并非多模态推理工作，迁移性需核查。
